current_round.method: native enqueue/start/complete and sync events joined to all 48 in-situ S0 routed-expert calls for 125 steady W2 Decode tokens
current_round.advantage: measures current real route order and consumer exposure without detached-replay distortion
current_round.limitation: current diagnostic did not persist hidden tensors or route IDs, so no new detached deterministic fixture was created

comparison.conclusion: current full-model CPU service is modestly slower than the old hot single-layer fixture, but its absolute total remains ~5.6 ms/token and is fully hidden before the consumer wait

disposition: No new detached replay is needed to decide the bottleneck; direct in-situ service and exposed wait are stronger for the current request. A future CPU-kernel project should add a persisted current hidden/route fixture before microkernel work.
